en.topic_title: CCTV cameras at Hong Kong malls to be linked to police surveillance network, says security chief
en.topic_summary:
The police are linking CCTV cameras at malls across the city to its AI-enabled SmartView surveillance system, Secretary for Security Chris Tang told TVB on Sunday.



A CCTV camera in Mong Kok. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Without naming the malls involved, Tang said the police force was in the final stages of discussion with private shopping centres, with an aim of bringing 60,000 cameras into the integrated police system by 2028.
